suggestions.signal_name: Petroleum inventory surprise vs refinery utilization
suggestions.observation: Inventory levels alone mix demand weakness and supply/refinery effects; utilization-adjusted surprises may better separate the mechanisms.
suggestions.rationale: A build caused by demand weakness should carry a different equity interpretation than a build caused by refinery outages or supply shocks.
suggestions.caveats: Requires additional EIA series and a fresh Dana data pass; not in current pair scope.
